title: Decide how nav treats sections with little in them
description: The nav has six destinations, some of them thin today. The review says it reflects the software more than the reader. Note that the branding plan assumes a mature, populated publication, so weigh this against that: changes should make sense for the mature site, not only for today's volume. Options include leading with Stories and Posts and grouping Findings, Videos, Conversations and Concepts as a second layer. Ryan decides.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done on develop, Ryan told me to finish it. Stories and Posts lead, with Findings, Videos, Conversations and Concepts as a quieter second group without pill backgrounds. Not released.
